android.desc:
Cloudflare Remote is a powerful mobile DNS and domain manager built for professionals who need full control of their Cloudflare infrastructure—anytime, anywhere.

Manage DNS records, firewall rules, SSL settings, analytics, and security features directly from your iPhone with a fast, secure, and intuitive interface.

No API key information is ever stored


DNS & DOMAIN MANAGEMENT


• Manage unlimited DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV)
• Create, edit, and delete DNS records instantly
• Real-time DNS propagation monitoring
• Bulk DNS management
• Quick response to DNS attacks with instant updates
• Multi-account support with fast switching

ANALYTICS & MONITORING

• Real-time traffic analytics dashboard
• Request counts, bandwidth usage, and visitor insights
• Cache hit rate & cached vs uncached traffic
• HTTP status code distribution (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx)
• Top countries traffic breakdown
• 24h, 7d, and 30d trend analysis

SECURITY & FIREWALL CONTROL

• Create and manage Firewall Rules with custom expressions
• IP Access Rules (IP, CIDR, Country, ASN)
• DDoS mitigation controls
• Security level adjustment (Low to Under Attack mode)
• DNSSEC configuration
• SSL/TLS management (Flexible, Full, Full Strict)
• Development Mode toggle
• Hotlink protection

ADVANCED FEATURES

• Page Rules and Redirect Rules
• Health Checks monitoring
• Cache purge functionality
• Browser Cache TTL settings
• HTTP/2, HTTP/3 (QUIC), IPv6 & WebSocket controls
• Brotli compression & Always Online

PRIVACY & DATA PROTECTION

• Credentials stored securely in your device Keychain
• No API key information is ever stored on servers
• No data collection or tracking
• Fully GDPR compliant

SUBSCRIPTIONS

Unlock advanced features with:
• Lifetime purchase
• Monthly subscription
• Yearly subscription

Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled 24 hours before renewal. Managed via your iTunes account.

Important:
Cloudflare Remote requires a Cloudflare account.
This is a third-party app using the Cloudflare API and is not affiliated with Cloudflare, Inc.

Download Cloudflare Remote and take full control of your DNS management today.
